Live Flows Captured & Visually Verified

Bugs Caught & Fixed During Live Simulator Testing

1. Missing Reanimated 4 Worklets Peer Metro export caught missing react-native-worklets for Reanimated 4 — installed via expo install; both iOS & Android Hermes bundles now compile cleanly.
2. Bottom Sheet & Floating Tab Bar Clearance Initial simulator inspection revealed PlaceDetailSheet Year Collections sitting behind the floating tab bar. Converted it to a floating rounded card above the bar and tuned upper-viewport camera framing.
3. Startup SQLite Hydration Race Live seeding revealed early writes could be overwritten before hydrate() resolved. Updated store hydration to merge in-flight edits safely.
4. iOS Status Bar, SafeAreaView & UK Tile Polish Fixed dark-on-dark status bar on Midnight Atlas, migrated deprecated SafeAreaView imports to react-native-safe-area-context (eliminating LogBox warnings), centered the Stats mini-map, and eliminated truncation on Northern Ireland.
